text: Ɓen wenjirooɓe Aayeeje Allah ɗen, fii bonnitirgol ɗe ko aldaa e hujja arɗo ɓe, kuuɗe maɓɓe ɗen mawnii tikkere mun ka Allah, e ka gomɗimɓe Mo gomɗini Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko wano Allah notiri non e ɓerɗe ɓee wenjooɓe ɗoo ɓen, O notirta e ɓernde kala mawnintinaniiɗo goonga, dundarankeejo feewnetaake e peewal maa e jam.
